context: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Gallstone Dissolution The recommended dose for ursodiol capsule treatment of radiolucent gallbladder stones is 8-10 mg/kg/day given in 2 or 3 divided doses. Ultrasound images of the gallbladder should be obtained at 6-month intervals for the first year of ursodiol
